✨ Cozy Chicken Lasagna ✨
The ultimate comfort meal — layered with my mom’s-style chicken bolognese and a creamy white sauce. Pure happiness in every bite ❤️

🧄 For the Bolognese:
1 tbsp oil
6 garlic cloves, minced + 1 tsp garlic paste
1 onion, finely chopped
1 carrot, grated
200g button mushrooms, chopped
450g chicken kheema (minced chicken)
4–5 tomatoes blended or 1 tin/bottle tomato sauce
½ cup water or veg stock
1 tbsp black pepper
1 tbsp dried basil / oregano / fresh basil
1 tbsp red chilli flakes
Handful chopped coriander / basil / parsley

🫕 For the White Sauce:
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp flour
2 cups milk
Salt + pepper to taste
Optional: pinch of nutmeg + cheese for creaminess

🍝 To Assemble:
Lasagna sheets
Grated mozzarella + cheddar
Butter/oil to grease dish

👩🏻‍🍳 Method:
1️⃣ Heat oil, add garlic + onions, sauté till fragrant.
2️⃣ Add carrots + mushrooms, cook till water evaporates.
3️⃣ Add chicken kheema, cook till browned.
4️⃣ Stir in tomato puree + water/stock.
5️⃣ Season with salt, pepper, basil, chilli flakes + herbs.
6️⃣ Simmer 15–20 mins till rich + thick.

➡️ For white sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, slowly add milk, season + cook till smooth.

7️⃣ Layer in dish: white sauce → lasagna sheets → bolognese → white sauce → repeat.
8️⃣ Top with cheese 🧀
9️⃣ Bake at 180°C / 350°F for 30–35 mins till golden + bubbly.

Let it rest for 10 mins before cutting… then enjoy your cozy masterpiece 🫶🏼✨
